skills.title: Risu System Builder
skills.summary: Design a new RisuAI charx or module as one coordinated Lua, Regex, Lorebook, HTML, and variable system.
skills.useWhen: Use when designing feature boundaries, artifact roles, and state flow for a new RisuAI system.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for auditing an existing workspace or tracing one variable flow only.

skills.title: Structured Output to UI Loop
skills.summary: Connect compact model output tags to Regex, HTML, Lua button handling, and variable feedback.
skills.useWhen: Use when model output tags must become UI cards, choices, buttons, or state changes.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for simple prose lorebook writing or read-only tracing.

skills.title: RisuAI Authoring Skill Structure Scout
skills.summary: Inspect concrete RisuAI examples and extract reusable creation patterns before drafting an authoring skill.
skills.useWhen: Use before writing any RisuAI authoring skill to inspect concrete examples and extract reusable creation patterns.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for auditing an existing workspace, tracing one variable flow, or producing read-only audit reports.

skills.title: Central Variable Store and Namespace
skills.summary: A schema-first authoring skill for keeping variable names, action IDs, and state keys consistent across large RisuAI systems.
skills.useWhen: Use when Lua, Regex, HTML, and Lorebook content share variables or IDs.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for a tiny prototype with only one or two variables.

skills.title: Stateful Panel and Button Kit
skills.summary: A UI-to-Lua authoring skill for building RisuAI HTML panels and stable button actions.
skills.useWhen: Use when building character sheets, inventories, skill trees, settings panels, or status dashboards.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for a static Lorebook feature that only emits prose.

skills.title: Output Hygiene and Hidden State
skills.summary: An authoring skill for preventing internal markers, save payloads, generated choices, and system-only blocks from polluting visible output or future prompts.
skills.useWhen: Use when implementation markers or generated UI blocks are appended to chat messages.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for completely stateless text-only features.

skills.title: RPG Skill Check Engine
skills.summary: An authoring skill for building an RPG check system with DCs, dice results, EXP, level-ups, and skill points.
skills.useWhen: Use when building TRPG-style checks, skill progression, or difficulty-based rewards.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for simple choices or pure narrative branching.

skills.title: Choice Generation and Reroll Loop
skills.summary: An authoring skill for generating constrained choices through an auxiliary LLM call and safely regenerating only the choice block.
skills.useWhen: Use when choices should be generated separately from the narrative body and can be rerolled.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use when the main model should freely write choices inside prose.

skills.title: Save Load Through Chat Payload
skills.summary: An authoring skill for storing gameplay state in hidden chat payloads and restoring it from history during initialization.
skills.useWhen: Use when state must survive chat reloads, regenerations, exports, imports, or session re-entry.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use when host state alone is enough and chat-history recovery is unnecessary.

skills.title: Perk Feature System
skills.summary: An authoring skill for unlockable features such as perks, traits, items, relationship bonuses, or status effects that influence both mechanics and prompts.
skills.useWhen: Use when unlockable features affect state, UI, and model-generated behavior.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for fixed flavor text or static lore only.

skills.title: State Machine Design
skills.summary: An authoring skill for RisuAI systems with long-running state transitions such as phases, modes, dungeons, decks, rosters, or combat turns.
skills.useWhen: Use when a module or character system changes mode or phase across multiple turns.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for a single button action or one-off structured output.

skills.title: Risu Choice Protocol Builder
skills.summary: An authoring skill for designing stable RisuAI choice button payloads, Lua dispatchers, and Lorebook choice contracts together.
skills.useWhen: Use when Regex/CBS buttons emit choice_* payloads and Lua must convert selections into user input or state changes.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use when choices are plain prose with no button handling or state feedback.

skills.title: Risu Start Setup Wizard Builder
skills.summary: An authoring skill for designing RisuAI first-message setup panels, guarded initial variables, and generated start input.
skills.useWhen: Use when language, difficulty, starting stats, background flags, or other initial settings must be configured through a one-time button UI.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use when a single user input can start the system without pre-start state or setup UI.

skills.title: Risu Dual-Flag State Machine Builder
skills.summary: An authoring skill for staging state changes in current/next slots during model output and committing them after output processing.
skills.useWhen: Use when a response must calculate next state while prompt/display logic still needs both previous and upcoming state.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for simple booleans or button toggles that do not need current/next staging.

skills.title: Risu UI Skin Contract Builder
skills.summary: An authoring skill for designing the contract between Regex-generated RisuAI markup and shared background.risuhtml CSS classes.
skills.useWhen: Use when Regex output creates repeated UI such as cards, status panels, gauges, or toggles that need a shared CSS skin.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for one-off plain text replacements or simple transforms without CSS.

skills.title: Deck Action Loop Template
skills.summary: An authoring skill for connecting card/deck action lists through model contracts, Lua parsers, hand UI, and button selection.
skills.useWhen: Use when hand, deck, or encounter actions are available each turn and selected actions must feed future prompts and state.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for a few fixed ordinary choices without deck, draw, discard, action cost, or effects.
